select "f"."id" as "id", "f"."table_id" as "table_id", "f"."type" as "type", "f"."is_computed" as "is_computed", "f"."is_lookup" as "is_lookup", "f"."is_conditional_lookup" as "is_conditional_lookup", "f"."options" as "options", "f"."lookup_options" as "lookup_options", CASE
            WHEN f.type != 'link' THEN true
            WHEN f.options::json->>'symmetricFieldId' IS NULL THEN true
            WHEN sf.id IS NULL THEN false
            WHEN sf.deleted_time IS NOT NULL THEN false
            WHEN sf.type != 'link' THEN false
            WHEN (sf.options::json->>'symmetricFieldId')::text IS NULL THEN false
            WHEN (sf.options::json->>'symmetricFieldId')::text != f.id THEN false
            ELSE true
          END as "symmetric_valid" from "field" as "f" inner join "table_meta" as "t" on "t"."id" = "f"."table_id" left join "table_meta" as "option_target" on (f.options::json->>'foreignTableId')::text = "option_target"."id" left join "table_meta" as "lookup_target" on (f.lookup_options::json->>'foreignTableId')::text = "lookup_target"."id" left join "field" as "sf" on (f.options::json->>'symmetricFieldId')::text = "sf"."id" where "f"."deleted_time" is null and COALESCE("f"."is_pending", false) = false and "t"."deleted_time" is null and "t"."provision_state" IN ($1) and (
            (f.options::json->>'foreignTableId') IS NULL
            OR (
              option_target.deleted_time IS NULL
              AND "option_target"."provision_state" IN ($2)
            )
          ) and (
            (f.lookup_options::json->>'foreignTableId') IS NULL
            OR (
              lookup_target.deleted_time IS NULL
              AND "lookup_target"."provision_state" IN ($3)
            )
          ) and "f"."id" in ($4)

select "r"."from_field_id" as "from_field_id", "r"."to_field_id" as "to_field_id", "f_from"."table_id" as "from_table_id", "f_to"."table_id" as "to_table_id", "f_to"."type" as "to_field_type", "t_from"."base_id" as "from_base_id", "t_to"."base_id" as "to_base_id" from (
              SELECT from_field_id, to_field_id FROM reference
              WHERE from_field_id IN ($1)
              UNION
              SELECT from_field_id, to_field_id FROM reference
              WHERE to_field_id IN ($2)
            ) as "r" inner join "field" as "f_from" on "f_from"."id" = "r"."from_field_id" inner join "field" as "f_to" on "f_to"."id" = "r"."to_field_id" inner join "table_meta" as "t_from" on "t_from"."id" = "f_from"."table_id" inner join "table_meta" as "t_to" on "t_to"."id" = "f_to"."table_id" where "f_from"."deleted_time" is null and "f_to"."deleted_time" is null and "t_from"."deleted_time" is null and "t_to"."deleted_time" is null and "t_from"."provision_state" IN ($3) and "t_to"."provision_state" IN ($4)
